_note: Seed for the boards. musashikosugi: shelters, their addresses and target areas were verified on 2026-11-02 against 川崎市地域防災計画 資料編 2-06 避難所（指定避難所）一覧表 (as of 令和7年4月1日) and 2-18 応急給水拠点 (https://www.city.kawasaki.jp/601/page/0000140630.html). shibuya: verified on 2026-11-04, target areas from 渋谷区地域防災計画（令和5年度修正）資料編 資料5 避難所一覧, names, addresses and closures from the 渋谷区 page 避難所・自主避難施設一覧 (updated 2026-07-03), shelters for stranded commuters from the 渋谷区防災ポータル list (updated 2026-07-21), the water station from 東京都水道局渋谷営業所 渋谷水道ミニ情報 令和7年9月号; sapporo: verified on 2026-11-05 against the 札幌市 pages 避難場所等（中央区） (updated 2026-06-30), 一時滞在施設 (updated 2026-03-06, list as of 令和6年8月) and the 水道局 page 拠点給水施設 (updated 2024-06-14); no shelter lies inside its 45 blocks and the city assigns none to them. hakata: verified on 2026-11-05 against the 福岡市 page 指定緊急避難場所及び指定避難所一覧 (updated 2024-08-28), the 通学区域 lists (as of 令和8年4月1日) for target areas, and the 一時滞在施設 agreements (as of 令和8年3月末). docs/BOARDS.md and docs/DEVLOG.md give the URLs. Area codes come from e-Stat 小地域 boundaries (scripts/geo). The admin token is generated by scripts/seed.ts and printed once; only its hash is stored.
